description_expanded: Along the irresistible Emerald Coast off 30A, this 5-bedroom home sleeps 12 and has a beautiful screened in porch to enjoy your morning coffee before hitting the beach. This home comes equipped with new inviting décor, ALL hardwood flooring, a gourmet kitchen with marble counter tops and stainless steel Bosch appliances, a large community pool, and cozy outdoor lounge furniture for you to relax on after a day at the beach or biking along the 30A. Kick back and enjoy the comfort of being in your vacation home away from home. Nestled in Seagrove, Young Haven has great living space with 2 king-master suites, 2 queens sharing a Jack and Jill bathroom, a bunk room with 4 twin bunks. One private master suite sits on the top floor with a private balcony allowing you to bask in the unique and serene sights and sounds of 30A. Spacious yet homey, it a perfect family vacation getaway. Book your next vacation at Young Haven, where relaxation awaits. What should I do in Paradise? 1. Layout at the community pool located right out your front door 2. Bike along 30A and stop at the local restaurants and bars 3. Take your family to The Hub and enjoy shopping, dining, and entertainment 4. Enjoy some of the world's most beautiful beaches Where to Eat? 1. Café 30A 2. Angelina's Pizzeria 3. Perfect Pig Grill and Fish House 4. Whiskey Bravo 5. Bud & Alley's Waterfront Restaurant & Bar There are so many options. If you would like more recommendations, please call the property manager for great local advice. What about the kids? 1. Call Paradise30A to rent bikes and explore Seaside, Seagrove, Seacrest, Dune Allen, and much more 2. Call Paradise30A and rent paddle boards, canoes, kayaks, or a golf cart and explore Grayton Beach and State Park 3. For more commercial attractions there are water parks, shopping, theaters, and more in the neighboring towns of Destin and Panama City Beach. Call Paradise30A or consult the Paradise30A app for more details. What else do I need to know about Young Haven? 1. No smoking 2. Must be 25 years old to rent 3. Check in at 4:00 PM, Check out at 10:00 AM 4. For a full list of rules please review the guest rental agreement
